role: Recurring illustration anchor for the double(x) worked example; a metaphor, not literal hardware.
mode: generate then one edit to flatten/simplify
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one reusable isolated editorial illustration / visual anchor for a vertical programming explainer called Studio Ribbon. This is a new asset, not a website screenshot.
Subject: an imaginative small transformation workshop, one broad simple forest-green tabletop machine with a clearly separated input tray on the left and output tray on the right; one small lively human operator in pale pink and citrus-lime clothing beside it. The mechanism is a metaphor for applying a function to an input. Leave the trays EMPTY so actual numbers and data can be overlaid in native video graphics later. Main readable silhouette at phone scale. No text or symbols are needed.
Style: sophisticated playful flat editorial illustration, screenprinted green organic silhouettes, slightly irregular contour linework in cream and pale pink, simplified elongated human figure, a few delicate line details and foliage-like organic flourishes, limited flat fills, subtle analog imperfection without heavy distress. Like a contemporary illustration studio's illustrated service icon, not a corporate stock vector or software UI.
Palette: deep evergreen #00624C dominant, blush pink #F0C6E5, citrus #CED443, warm ivory #F7F4ED. At most one tiny orange #FF702E detail. No gradients or glossy light.
Composition: horizontal readable grouping occupying the middle 80% of the canvas, roomy transparent margin, complete silhouette with no cropping, genuine transparent background. Make one coherent standalone illustration, not a sheet of icons or a mockup.
Constraints: NO letters, numbers, code, badges, watermarks, logos, arrows, charts, realistic photography, 3D materials, bevels, drop shadows or disconnected floating objects. Keep the two trays clear and easy to identify; illustration is not an exact logic diagram.
edit_prompt: Edit this illustration as a production-ready transparent cutout. Preserve the woman, workshop machine, two empty trays, composition and evergreen/blush/citrus/ivory palette. Remove ALL atmospheric glow, dark haze, colored halos, vignette, gradients and shadows surrounding the subjects. Pixels outside the actual woman/machine/trays/leaves must be fully transparent, with only normal antialiased edges. Keep the interior as crisp flat editorial color shapes and restrained contour linework; reduce grain rather than adding any lighting. Do not add text, symbols or objects. Keep the complete silhouette and empty trays.
review: RGBA confirmed; sampled empty background pixels have alpha 0. No generated letters/code. Two empty trays preserved; exact values and logic are native. Review at layout size before use.
